This is a fully remote opportunity.   
 Gradient AI:       
 Gradient AI is revolutionizing Group Health and P&C insurance with AI-powered solutions that help insurers predict risk more accurately, improve profitability, and automate underwriting and claims. Our SaaS platform taps into one of the industry’s largest data lakes—tens of millions of policies and claims—to deliver deep, actionable insights. Trusted by leading carriers, MGAs, TPAs, and self-insured employers, Gradient AI has grown rapidly since our founding in 2018. Backed by $56M in Series C funding, we're scaling fast—and it's an exciting time to join the team.   
 About the Role:   
 Gradient AI is looking for a Program Operations Specialist to own project and case management across our health underwriting products. This person will manage a portfolio of clients from implementation through ongoing service, driving cross-functional coordination, process improvement, and reporting so our operations run proactively rather than reactively.   
 How You Will Make an Impact   
- Own project and case management across our health underwriting products, from intake and prioritization through assignment and end to end tracking.
- Maintain a centralized, client by client view of status, timelines, dependencies, risks, and priorities across the portfolio.
- Partner with Product, Data Science, Data Engineering, Implementation, QA, and Client Executives to drive follow through, confirm progress, and resolve blockers without relying on formal authority.
- Drive process improvement and automation across project and case management, using deep fluency in Salesforce, Jira, and spreadsheet trackers to find opportunities to streamline.
- Connect workflows and data across systems to build scalable solutions that improve tracking, reporting, and visibility, reducing reliance on manual, fragmented processes.
- Build standardized, data driven reporting on ticket volume, aging, bottlenecks, resolution rates, and workload to give teams and leadership actionable visibility.
- Evolve the function from reactive coordination to a proactive, data driven operating model by closing process gaps and increasing efficiency, accountability, and visibility.
 Skills Needed to Succeed   
- 5+ years of experience, ideally in service delivery, implementation management, issue and case management, or project and program coordination.
- Experience at a software or SaaS company is expected, insurance industry experience is a plus but not required.
- Strong working knowledge of Jira, Excel, and Salesforce, with the ability to build and maintain reports, dashboards, and trackers.
- Comfortable working with technical teams like Data Science and Data Engineering, translating between technical detail and business priorities.
- Comfortable managing many concurrent workstreams with different owners and no single defined end date.
- Strong organizational skills and follow through, with the ability to hold cross functional teams accountable without direct authority over them.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate ticket level detail into portfolio level visibility for leadership.
 What We Offer:   
- A fun, team-oriented startup culture.   
- Generous stock options — we all get to own a piece of what we’re building.   
- Unlimited vacation days.   
- Flexible schedule that supports working from home.   
- Full benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid parental leave, and more.   
- Ample opportunities to learn and take on new responsibilities.   
 We are an equal opportunity employer.   
 Salary Range: $115,000-140,000 base salary annually.

Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a People Strategy Partner to join our People Strategy team.
 Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.
 About the role: 
 The People Strategy Partner role empowers departmental leaders in achieving their department goals. This is done by supporting leaders in aligning their strategic outcomes to broader company objectives and ensuring that the right roadmaps, management processes and talent are in place to achieve outcomes. This role will have a deep understanding of the functions' operations allowing them to assess their effectiveness, as well as provide feedback and insight on the function, functional leader and team performance. This role will be a strategic thought partner to business leaders as they work through human capital processes, connect dots and build stakeholder alignment across the organization.
 You will report into the VP, People Strategy and HR.
 Work Location: This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid
 Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $135,792- $178,227, per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.
 Responsibilities: 
- Assist leaders with the development and maintenance of departmental strategy including mid-level outcomes, stakeholder management, management processes, etc.
- Support leaders in driving overall talent strategy and talent management for department
- Be proactive and anticipate change, providing critical and timely input about consequences and implications of local law and best practices to all internal stakeholders
- Support and train managers to coach their team and take disciplinary actions if needed; counseling managers.
- Influence senior leadership through synthesized themes and business needs
- Provide strategic insight to leadership to enable them to see around corners
- Be a consistent thought partner on a broad set of issues, providing ongoing feedback.
- Support a culture of trust, promoting open & honest communication. Train and coach managers and employees on best practices and adhering to company values.
- Partner cross functionally within the People team on the development and change management of new programming and assist in facilitating ongoing programming with business stakeholders
- Work with managers to maintain efficient organizational structures
- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
- Other duties as assigned
 Requirements: 
- 6+ years work experience of People Team Experience
- 4+ years experience with leadership principles, frameworks, and industry practices related to team performance such as talent management, professional development, organizational design, workforce planning.
 Bonus points: 
- Human Resources Professional Certification (e.g., PHR, SPHR, SHRM) 
- Consulting Skills
- Workday experience

Join phData , a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.
 We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.
 Why phData? 
- Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years , and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
- AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
- 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
- 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
- 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year 
- Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network 
- #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
- 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
- Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US , India and LATAM 
 We are looking for a Commercial Life Sciences leader to help grow and scale phData's Life Sciences - Commercial business across data, analytics, and AI. You'll lead go-to-market development for our commercial offerings while staying close enough to delivery to shape practical, high-value client solutions - across market access, pricing and reimbursement, patient services, commercial operations, omnichannel, payer analytics, and gross-to-net.
 You'll spend most of your energy shaping market-facing offerings, supporting strategic pursuits, and advising clients - and you'll own the development of the commercial offerings themselves: defining what they are, what they're worth, and what they need to succeed. 
 What You'll Do 
 Drive Customer Outcomes. Stay relentlessly focused on the client's end goals, evaluating and applying the right data, AI, and platform technologies to deliver tangible business and patient value. Sharpen where phData can credibly win by pairing commercial domain knowledge with data, analytics, AI, and cloud capabilities.
 Serve as a Trusted Advisor. Build strong relationships with commercial, analytics, and data leaders and act as a credible thought partner. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders, give customers access to dollars through virtual accounts, and disburse USD globally.
 About the team 
 We are seeking a Senior Treasury Specialist to oversee capital adequacy, liquidity stress testing, financial risk management, and contingency funding planning for Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB)'s Treasury and Reserve Operations. Issuing digital assets that are fully backed by reserves raises new questions for a regulated bank: how much capital and liquidity it needs, how it holds up under stress, and how it shows management, the Board, and regulators that it is safe and sound.
 What you'll do 
 In this role, you will support Stripe’s proposed national trust bank, Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB), currently in formation and subject to full regulatory approval by the OCC. You will build and run the bank's capital, liquidity, and financial risk management framework and the governance around it. That includes the analysis, monitoring, policies, and reporting that let the bank grow safely as regulatory requirements for stablecoin issuers continue to evolve.
 You will partner closely with the BNTB Treasury and Reserve Operations team, the broader Bridge and Stripe treasury team, risk, compliance, finance, accounting, regulatory reporting, product, data science, and engineering. In the near term, you will help design the frameworks and put the first cycles into practice. As the bank scales, you will turn them into repeatable, automated processes.
 Responsibilities 
- Own capital planning and the ongoing assessment of the bank's capital adequacy
- Own and report on capital, liquidity, and financial risk metrics against risk appetite and limits; escalate breaches and emerging trends
- Design and run liquidity and capital stress testing, and turn the results into recommendations for funding and capital strategy
- Own contingency funding planning, including annual testing and tracking remediation to closure
- Maintain treasury risk policies and procedures, and prepare management and Board reporting
- Provide risk oversight of reserve and investment activity (counterparty, concentration, liquidity and interest rate risk); partner with product, data science, and engineering to automate monitoring and reporting
- Coordinate with the broader Stripe treasury team on capital management initiatives including consolidated capital planning, infrastructure and methodology development and governance frameworks
 Who you are

About Faire 
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
 About this role 
 We're looking for a strategic, analytical leader to drive the growth and performance of new products on Faire. Ensuring retailers have access to the freshest, most relevant products is critical to building a thriving marketplace, and this role will help shape how we measure and unlock that opportunity.
 In this role, you'll own the forecasting, business intelligence, and go-to-market strategy for New Product GMV and Out of Stocks, translating complex marketplace dynamics into actionable insights and strategic priorities. You'll develop a deep understanding of business performance and partner closely with Revenue, Product and Data Science teams to develop and execute needle moving go-to-market strategies that drive product availability and growth.
 This is an ideal role for someone who wants to work as a high-impact individual contributor in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and data-driven environment. This is a high-visibility role where you'll regularly present strategic insights and recommendations to Faire's leadership team, and your work will directly drive positive impact for Faire and our customers.
 What you’ll do 
- Own the most important metrics for our business by having deep intuition on how they are trending and surfacing the most salient strategic insights to drive them
- Break down complex and ambiguous strategic problems, identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, execute in-depth analyses and make recommendations to Faire’s leadership team
- Develop, refine, and execute on go-to-market strategies
- Lead large cross-functional strategic initiatives that move company metrics in partnership with Product, Sales, Systems, Program Management, Marketing, etc.
- Provide thought partnership to cross functional teammates to ensure the organization is using data thoughtfully and correctly
- Develop effective and scalable operational processes and fill operational gaps
 Qualifications 
- 8+ years of relevant work experience in an analytical and strategic role across analytics, consulting, product, business operations, or finance
- You are a strategic problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and apply a first principles approach to solving them.
- You are highly analytical and metrics-focused. You can execute on complex analyses, define KPIs, size opportunity areas, and measure and report on performance across the business
- Advanced technical skill set and strong proficiency in Excel + SQL
- You are a strong communicator. You can crisply communicate actionable data-driven insights to all audiences.
- You have strong product and business intuition. You contextualize how insights fit into broader business goals and have a strong understanding of product and business metrics.
- You are scrappy and resourceful. When something needs to get done, you always find a way to make it happen.
- You are an extraordinarily fast learner. You have the natural curiosity and intellectual horsepower to deeply understand new topics and pick up new skills in a very short time.
 Salary Range 
 San Francisco / New York City: the pay range for this role is $197,500 - $271,500 per yea

About Figure 
 Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies .
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist, Property Analytics to join our growing team! As Senior Applied Scientist, Property Analytics, you’ll help us reinvent real estate lending by tackling complex research and machine learning problems related to automated valuation models (AVMs), asset valuation, and process optimization. You’ll work alongside engineering, product, and business leaders on a team of 360-degree thinkers who combine advanced analytics and machine learning skills with deep domain knowledge, using some of the most fascinating data sets in the world. You’ll lead technical direction, mentor team members, and partner closely with MLOps engineers, Product Managers, Credit Risk Management, and Capital Markets subject matter experts to drive strategic initiatives from initial research to production deployment.
 What You’ll Do 
- Lead the end-to-end design, architecture, development, and deployment of state-of-the-art automated valuation modeling (AVM) systems for novel lending products
- Architect and refine innovative machine learning, deep learning, and statistical models for asset valuation, incorporating spatial-temporal trends, macroeconomic factors, market liquidity, and property risk dynamics
- Establish robust quantitative frameworks for continuous model performance assessment, monitoring, and automated retraining across changing real estate cycles
- Build analytical tools and frameworks to empower cross-functional teams across risk, underwriting, and capital markets
- Partner closely with data infrastructure and MLOps engineering teams to drive initiatives that enhance data capabilities, build feature stores, and streamline real-time inference infrastructure
- Design useful data attributes and feature representations, leveraging structured, unstructured, and multimodal data sources (for example, property photos, listing descriptions, and spatial features)
- Perform exploratory data analysis, evaluate frontier AI capabilities, and make strategic recommendations to improve current decisioning frameworks and valuation accuracy
- Refactor and optimize existing analytical solutions and algorithmic components to improve scalability, reliability, and execution efficiency
 What We Look For 
- Ph.D. or Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (for example, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, or Machine Learning) with 5+ years of industry experience (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.) building and deploying machine learning models in production
- Proven track record of developing statistical and machine learning models at an account, customer, or real estate asset level
- Solid understanding and hands-on application of advanced machine learning techniques, deep learning, spatial analytics, and AI capabilities
- Strong production-level programming skills in Python, SQL, and R

About the Role 
 Location: Fully remote within the continental United States. 
 Use of AI data in insurance pricing entails regulatory review by state departments of insurance. When a carrier intends to use Nearmap data in its rates, both the carrier’s own actuaries and state insurance regulators can come back with various questions and/or objections. Many are predictable and specific: how was ground truth for an attribute determined, what do the goodness-of-fit metrics look like on held-out data? Others have never been asked before and have yet to be fully answered. 
 You will be the actuarial voice inside Nearmap’s and our customers’ rate filings. Working with our AI and Computer Vision team, you will build a library of validation materials behind every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating, produce exhibits and memos for state DOI review, and answer regulator objections with analysis that holds up under scrutiny.

Job Description: 
At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.
We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—We invite you to join over 3,000 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to lift lives, one cross-border story at a time.
 About the Role: 
 Remitly is looking for a proactive, highly organized Senior Executive Business Partner to support our CEO and a second senior executive. You will report to the Senior Program Manager in the Office of the CEO. You will own the administrative world for both leaders end to end and build the systems that keep it running smoothly, so their time goes to what matters most. We're looking for someone who thinks ahead about AI and will find new ways to use AI tools to raise the bar for executive support. As the executive support presence in our New York office, you will also be the onsite point of contact for CEO events and visitors there. 
 This role is based in New York City and requires at least three days a week in office, with more time for events and key onsite meetings. Regular travel to Seattle is expected.
 You Will: 
- Own both executives' calendars end to end. Schedule complex internal and external meetings across time zones, weigh competing requests, and keep each calendar the single source of truth.
- Run travel for both executives as a program, including complex domestic and international trips.
- Manage expenses for both executives and coordinate operational needs, including contracts, procurement, and invoices.
- Anticipate what each executive needs and resolve friction before it reaches them. Make sure they and the people they meet with are prepared for every meeting: coordinate materials with team members and push meeting owners early for what's needed.
- Build systems that bring structure to both offices: regular rhythms, trackers, and routines so each executive always knows what to expect and nothing slips.
- Use AI tools and automation to make both offices run better, and share what works with the EBP team.
- Maintain an external relationships tracker for both executives and screen inbound requests to protect their time. Coordinate the CEO's investor, media, and speaking engagements in partnership with Investor Relations and Communications.
- Provide in-person support in New York for CEO moments, including Board meetings, earnings, and investor visits.
- Serve as the onsite point of contact for the New York office: host guests and route office issues to the right teams.
- Partner with the Senior Program Manager on leadership offsites and CEO culture moments.
- Work with other EBPs on events, coverage, and company initiatives.
 You Have: 
- 7+ years supporting C-level executives, ideally including a public-company CEO, with complex calendars and international travel.
- Experience supporting more than one senior executive at a time, with the judgment to balance competing priorities.
- A track record of building repeatable systems and processes that bring structure and predictability to an executive's work.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools in your work, and curiosity about how AI can change executive support.
- A track record of owning work from start to finish, not just executing tasks, in a fast-growing, ambiguous environment.
- Excellent judgment and discretion with highly confidential information

If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.
 Job Overview:  
 Humanitarian needs are rising while funding falls. We believe AI, used well, can help close that gap. So we are transforming how the IRC works. We are giving staff across the organization AI tools and training. We are reshaping core work like supply chain and finance. And we are reinventing how we reach people in crisis, from detecting health threats earlier to putting an AI coach in the hands of teachers and parents.
 We are hiring a Manager, AI Transformation Portfolio to join the small central team that keeps this work coordinated, visible, and on track. You will track progress across a portfolio of about 40 projects, spot risks early, and make sure senior leaders have what they need to decide. You will coordinate internal communications on the transformation. And you will work directly with the IRC’s AI Executive Lead, its Chief Information Officer, and members of the Executive Board, the IRC’s senior-most leaders.
 This is a 12-month role with a clear mission: help the IRC move its AI priorities from pilot to scale. We are building the structure as we go. You will bring order to ambiguity, hold owners to their commitments, and build practices that departments can run on their own as the work matures. This is not a technical role, but you will use Claude and other AI tools every day to do it well.

- The Executive Board has a clear, current picture of AI spend, use cases deployed, and impact, without a heavy reporting burden on project teams. à You will refine and maintain the high efficiency, AI-enabled system that enables this visibility.  
- Enterprise-wide risks have been identified and managed early. à You will spot and escalate key risks. 
- Departments are advancing their own AI priorities with minimal duplication. à You will help automate and simplify the tracking system so that, as directed by the Director, it can extend to projects outside the starting priority set without adding staff time for project teams. 
 Additionally, you will help build broader organizational awareness for the IRC’s transformation agenda down to the impacts and learnings of specific projects.

Sr. Manager, Social Strategy   
 This role is to be based near either New York City or Philadelphia 
 About us:    
 We drive intelligent growth for ambitious businesses and leading brands.   
 Customer understanding is more potent and drives greater value when insights go to work directly within marketing and experience priorities. To give our clients that advantage, we put an insights-driven operating system at the core of our design, go-to-market and digital experience solutions.    
 Material clients make smarter growth choices because they can see clearly how and when to take the shots that count. Together, we connect consumer intelligence with customer demand generation to build lasting, profitable relationships.  
 About the Sr. Manager, Social Strategy   
 We are seeking a Sr. Manager, Social Strategy   to lead the development of audience-centric social strategies that help brands earn relevance, build community, and drive business impact in an increasingly connected and culture-driven landscape.  
 In this role, you will bring deep expertise across social platforms, audience behavior, content strategy, and cultural intelligence to uncover opportunities for brands to show up in meaningful and authentic ways. You understand that effective social strategy lives at the intersection of consumer insights, brand values, platform dynamics, and culture. By connecting these elements, you will help brands create content ecosystems that resonate with audiences, inspire engagement, and strengthen long-term brand affinity.  
 As a core member of the team, you will partner closely with Creative, Insights, Analytics, Media, and Client Services to translate audience needs, emerging trends, and social behaviors into actionable strategic recommendations. You are equal parts strategist, storyteller, and trusted advisor, with a passion for helping brands navigate the evolving social landscape and identify the conversations, communities, and cultural moments that matter most.  
 The ideal candidate brings a strong point of view on how social can drive brand growth through purposeful content, community engagement, creator and influencer ecosystems, and culturally relevant storytelling. They are energized by turning insights into strategic frameworks that help brands build deeper connections with people, earn attention in crowded feeds, and create lasting relevance beyond individual campaigns.  
 Key Responsibilities    
- Executive Client Leadership & Presentation:  Act as the primary strategic client lead, driving client relationship growth and presenting high-impact decks directly to Director, VP, and executive-level client stakeholders.  
- Social-First Strategy : Develop social-first strategic frameworks grounded in audience insights, cultural relevance, and brand positioning. Define how brands can authentically participate in conversations, communities, and moments that matter, establishing a clear role for social in driving audience engagement and brand growth.  
- Audience & Content Ecosystem Mapping:  Identify audience motivations, behaviors, and unmet needs to develop platform-specific content strategies. Define audience segments, content pillars, engagement approaches, and creator opportunities that build relevance and foster ongoing community participation  
- Insight & Trend Translation:  Synthesize social listening, consumer research, performance data, and emerging cultural trends to uncover actionable opportunities for brands. Translate insights into strategic recommendations that strengthen audience connection, cultural resonance, and market differentiation.  
- Strategic Narrative & Storytelling:  Distill raw data, research, and channel mechanics into executive-ready narratives and actionable business recommendations.   
- Measurement & Optimization:  Establish social KPIs and measurement frameworks that evaluate channel performance and quantify social's contribution to broader marketing and business outcome

About Bullish 
 Bullish is an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services. These include:   Bullish   Exchange   – a regulated and institutionally focused digital assets spot and derivatives exchange, integrating a high-performance central limit order book matching engine with automated market making to provide deep and predictable liquidity. Bullish Exchange is regulated in Germany, Hong Kong, and Gibraltar.   CoinDesk   Indices   – a collection of tradable proprietary and single-asset benchmarks and indices that track the performance of digital assets for global institutions in the digital assets and traditional finance industries.   CoinDesk   Data   - a broad suite of digital assets market data and analytics, providing real-time insights into prices, trends, and market dynamics.   CoinDesk   Insights   – a digital asset media and events provider and operator of   Coindesk.com , a digital media platform that covers news and insights about digital assets, the underlying markets, policy, and blockchain technology. 
 Reports to: 
Head of Exchange and Custody Operations 
 Position Overview 
We’re seeking an Exchange Operations Specialist to join our team and drive the future of digital asset trading. You'll be at the forefront of Bullish operations, ensuring the seamless and secure functioning of our NYSE-listed exchange. If you're ready to take on an exciting operations role at the intersection of capital markets and cutting-edge financial
technology, we want to hear from you.
 Responsibilities: 
- Exchange and Client Excellence: You will fine-tune the platform to make sure trading is fast and reliable, providing high-quality support for our institutional clients. By keeping the trading environment top-notch, you establish the trust from clients and grow our business.
- Trading Algorithm & Execution Support: Engineering low-latency "algorithmic trading paths", scaling infrastructure to handle millions of transactions during market spikes, ensuring the trading algorithm can recover rapidly, and implementing security measures to detect unusual trade bursts.
- Be the Bridge Between Trading and Tech: Serve as a critical link between our sales teams, institutional clients, and technology organization. You will collaborate with Product and Engineering to support new products and features, ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into the live trading environment.
- Drive Strategic Optimization: This isn't just about keeping the lights on. We want you to constantly hunt for opportunities to improve and automate. You will lead projects to enhance client workflows and operational processes, directly contributing to platform efficiency, risk reduction, and our ability to scale.
- Shape Business Strategy with Data: Build and maintain powerful dashboards and reports that correlate deep technical metrics with key business KPIs. Your insights will empower our executive team to make data-driven strategic decisions.
- Uphold Market Integrity: Work in close partnership with our Finance, Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams to navigate the complex regulatory landscape of digital assets, ensuring a robust governance structure is maintained across all exchange activities.
 Experience & Qualifications: 
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Technology or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant experience with 2+ years in a trading operations, or trade support management role within digital assets, FinTech, or electronic trading.
- You have a strong background and deep understanding of trading, market structure, and the full order lifecycle.
- You are technically proficient and have hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting complex electronic trading systems running in the cloud. You are comfortable diving into system logs, diagnosing issues, and working with engineers to resolve them
- Proficient in Linux/Unix command-line environments and Bash scripti

Associate Actuary – Casualty Specialty Markets 
 At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Associate Actuary – Casualty Specialty Markets to take on key responsibilities within a world-class actuarial function.
 Make your mark in Actuarial 
 Our Actuaries are on the front lines, quantifying risk, pricing insurance and reserving losses for AIG’s major insurance operating companies, globally. We collaborate with Finance, Claims, Operations, Marketing and Risk Management, among other functions. As an AIG actuary, you will be challenged and encouraged to reach your greatest potential to help improve how we predict, manage and mitigate risk.
 How you will create an impact 
We are seeking an actuary with industry expertise to provide pricing, analytics, and technical support to the Energy, Trucking and Environmental Portfolios, with a focus on Commercial Auto Liability under the supervision of Casualty Specialty Market lead pricing actuary.  This position involves profitability analysis / deep dive, rater development and maintenance, large accounts pricing review, monthly business KPI reporting, assisting with annual budget and setting portfolio strategy.  Additional duties include supporting quarterly earnings-related reporting, business AvE, diagnostics and large loss reporting.   They will partner with other actuaries in implementing best practices, analytical techniques and assessing the impact of loss trends and claims emergence.   Also, they will be responsible for one direct report.
- Work closely with underwriting to develop pricing, underwriting strategies, identify pockets of profitable growth opportunities and future underwriting actions.
- Support the business review process and portfolio deep dives, which include reviewing underwriting actions impacting loss ratios to access impact on current and future performance.
- Ensure accuracy of quoting and rating systems by working with Underwriters.
- Ensure execution of rate level indications, portfolio profitability exercise and rate reviews within planned time frame
- Collaborate with data team to drive process improvement and achieve actuarial transformation goals
- Development and production of premium adequacy reports and budget loss ratio estimates for various segments.
- Perform peer review for actuarial work products.
- Communicate with and advise senior management, underwriters, comptrollers, claims department. 
- Work effectively as part of a team and train junior staff to achieve AIG’s financial, strategic and operational objectives
 What we are lookingh for 
- At least an Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS)
- At least 5 years of commercial lines actuarial experience, preferably with significant commercial auto pricing experience.
- Exceptional communication skills, including ability to develop and present clear and concise analysis and recommendations to senior management.
- Willing and able to continuously learn and adapt in a dynamic and fast changing environment. 
- Timeliness and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Snowflake, Python, R, or other programming languages preferred
 The base salary range for this position is $120,00-$150,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits Overview

 A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE 
 As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. 
 We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!   
 If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.  
 At PGIM, You Can!  
 What you will do 
 In this role, you'll play a key part in supporting PGIM's Alternative Investment Operations platform.  The Associate will be responsible for the support of all settlement activities as they relate to USD Bank Loans as well as assist where needed with any non-USD bank loans. This includes data integrity, trade communications/settlements.  The role requires extensive collaboration with Portfolio Management, Deal Teams, Legal, Compliance, Counterparties, Custodians, Trustees, and Agent Banks to ensure the accurate and timely execution of transactions and ongoing portfolio support.

 The Associate will be responsible for the support of all settlement activities as they relate to USD Bank Loans as well as assist where needed with any non-USD bank loans.  This position is based in our office in Newark, NJ and will follow a hybrid schedule. - Candidate will be responsible for coordinating with trade counterparties/ borrower to receive, review loan trade documentation, and facilitate the KYC/Onboarding of any new accounts.

- Proactively seeking ways to improve current processes by leveraging the tools available to identify inefficiencies.
- Cultivating both internal and external relationships to ensure proper service levels are achieved

PBF Energy Inc. (NYSE:PBF) is one of the largest independent refiners in North America, operating through its subsidiaries, oil refineries and related facilities.
